welcometosolana.xyz

Purpose: A single interface for moving assets to Solana from 50+ source
chains, plus a directory of the Solana ecosystem. The bridge covers Ethereum and EVM chains, Cosmos chains, and
non-EVM chains including Bitcoin, Tron, XRP and TON. Users keep custody
throughout; the site holds no funds and generates no deposit addresses of
its own.

Canonical: https://welcometosolana.xyz/
Sitemap: https://welcometosolana.xyz/sitemap.xml
Source: https://github.com/Medniyy/welcometosolana

Key sections:
- Bridge to Solana: https://welcometosolana.xyz/#migrate
- Choose a wallet: https://welcometosolana.xyz/#wallets
- Ecosystem directory: https://welcometosolana.xyz/ecosystem-new.html
- Who built this: https://welcometosolana.xyz/#creators

Notes for summarisation:
- The bridge shows the exact amount that will arrive before the user commits.
- A 0.5% service fee is included in every quote and disclosed in the interface.
- Provider links are not endorsements, and nothing on the site is financial
  advice.
